newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Robotics up after upbeat presentation.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Robotics up after upbeat presentation.

text.p: U.S. Robotics Corp jumped after the company made an upbeat presentation at a Morgan Stanley investment conference, analysts said.
U.S. Robotics gained 4-1/2 to 73 on Wednesday, recovering from last week's selloff, which was sparked by negative comments from an industry analyst.
U.S. Robotics confirmed that its executives spoke at the conference but declined to provide additional details.

On Monday, the Skokie, Illinois-based company said about 100 Internet service providers now support its x2 modem technology, which allows users to receive information nearly twice as fast as common modems.
U.S. Robotics recently launched preliminary beta testing of the x2 modem. The company is also seeking U.S. Federal Communications Commision certification for the modem.
